hinglishTracks.en: The world does not lack climate declarations.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — दुनिया में जलवायु संबंधी घोषणाओं की कमी नहीं है।।

hinglishTracks.en: They simply do not have the speed, resources, and cooperation required to make them a reality
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — उन्हें वास्तविकता में बदलने के लिए आवश्यक गति, संसाधन और सहयोग उनके पास नहीं है। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Cooperation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Cooperation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: Climate change is no longer a distant concern.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — जलवायु परिवर्तन अब कोई दूर की चिंता नहीं है।।

hinglishTracks.en: The question is no longer whether countries should act, but whether they can turn promises into praxis quickly and fairly.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — सवाल अब यह नहीं है कि देशों को कार्रवाई करनी चाहिए या नहीं, बल्कि सवाल यह है कि क्या वे वादों को जल्दी और निष्पक्षता से अमल में ला सकते हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: During COP29 in Baku in 2024, countries agreed to provide up to $300 billion dollars per year to developing countries by 2035.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — 2024 में बाकू में COP29 के दौरान, देश 2035 तक विकासशील देशों को प्रति वर्ष $300 बिलियन डॉलर तक प्रदान करने पर सहमत हुए।।

hinglishTracks.en: They also called for the mobilisation of $1.3 trillion a year from public and private sectors.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — उन्होंने सार्वजनिक और निजी क्षेत्रों से प्रति वर्ष 1.3 ट्रिलियन डॉलर जुटाने का भी आह्वान किया।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Mobilisation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Mobilisation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: While these commitments acknowledge that there is a need for vulnerable countries to receive more support, the true test is whether the funds are delivered on time to countries at affordable prices and in a usable format.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — हालाँकि ये प्रतिबद्धताएँ स्वीकार करती हैं कि कमजोर देशों को अधिक समर्थन प्राप्त करने की आवश्यकता है, लेकिन सच्ची परीक्षा यह है कि क्या देशों को समय पर किफायती कीमतों पर और उपयोगी प्रारूप में धनराशि वितरित की जाती है।।

hinglishTracks.en: United Nations (climate change) / climate change (politics) / Climate resilience/adaptation
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — संयुक्त राष्ट्र (जलवायु परिवर्तन) / जलवायु परिवर्तन (राजनीति) / जलवायु लचीलापन/अनुकूलन। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Resilience' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: लचीलापन और मज़बूती — किसी बड़े संकट या मंदी के बाद तेज़ी से वापस उभरने की क्षमता। इसके Synonyms हैं: Robustness, Endurance, Adaptability और Antonyms हैं: Fragility, Vulnerability, Weakness।

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #27 of 30 (19 NOV)

📰 Climate promises need to become praxis

📌 Published: 19 Nov 2026, 01:27:39 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The world does not lack climate declarations. They simply do not have the speed, resources, and cooperation required to make them a reality

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Climate change is no longer a distant concern. The question is no longer whether countries should act, but whether they can turn promises into praxis quickly and fairly. During COP29 in Baku in 2024, countries agreed to provide up to $300 billion dollars per year to developing countries by 2035. They also called for the mobilisation of $1.3 trillion a year from public and private sectors. While these commitments acknowledge that there is a need for vulnerable countries to receive more support, the true test is whether the funds are delivered on time to countries at affordable prices and in a usable format.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: United Nations (climate change) / climate change (politics) / Climate resilience/adaptation

Resilience (Noun)
लचीलापन और मज़बूती — किसी बड़े संकट या मंदी के बाद तेज़ी से वापस उभरने की क्षमता।
✓ Syn: Robustness, Endurance, Adaptability  |  ✖ Ant: Fragility, Vulnerability, Weakness
Mobilisation (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Mobilisation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Cooperation (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Cooperation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Adaptation (Noun)
अनुकूलन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Adaptation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🚀 Science, Tech & Environment passage on "Climate promises need to become praxis", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?

C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Climate promises need to become praxis' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Climate promises need to become praxis' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "The world does not lack climate declarations." (Hinglish Arth: दुनिया में जलवायु संबंधी घोषणाओं की कमी नहीं है।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Climate promises need to become praxis"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. United Nations (climate change) / climate change (politics) / Climate resilience/adaptation.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. 🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #28 of 30 (19 NOV)

📰 COP31 must not leave the next generation with a climate bill

📌 Published: 19 Nov 2026, 01:24:19 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: As the climate summit enters its final week in Antalya, developing countries are still fighting for the finance they were promised

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Imagine a child born in Nepal today. By the time she starts school, her country may still be rebuilding roads, bridges, and homes destroyed by floods. By the time she is old enough to work, her government could still be repaying loans taken out to recover from disasters that struck before she was born. She will inherit a changing climate. Must she inherit the debt as well?

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: United Nations (climate change) / climate change (politics) / Climate resilience/adaptation

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Resilience (Noun)
लचीलापन और मज़बूती — किसी बड़े संकट या मंदी के बाद तेज़ी से वापस उभरने की क्षमता।
✓ Syn: Robustness, Endurance, Adaptability  |  ✖ Ant: Fragility, Vulnerability, Weakness
Adaptation (Noun)
अनुकूलन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Adaptation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Finance (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Finance' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Developing (Verb / Participle)
विकासशील — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Developing' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Accelerate, Facilitate, Reinforce  |  ✖ Ant: Hinder, Obstruct, Weaken

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🚀 Science, Tech & Environment passage on "COP31 must not leave the next generation with a climate bill", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. As the climate summit enters its final week in Antalya, developing countries are still fighting for the finance they were promised.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'COP31 must not leave the next generation with a ' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'COP31 must not leave the next generation with' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'COP31 must not leave the next generation with' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "As the climate summit enters its final week in Antalya, developing countries are still fighting for the finance they were promised." (Hinglish Arth: जैसे ही अंताल्या में जलवायु शिखर सम्मेलन अपने अंतिम सप्ताह में प्रवेश कर रहा है, विकासशील देश अभी भी उस वित्त के लिए संघर्ष कर रहे हैं जिसका उनसे वादा किया गया था)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "COP31 must not leave the next generation with a climate bill"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. United Nations (climate change) / climate change (politics) / Climate resilience/adaptation.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The Ministry must act without delay and issue a statutory notification, consistent with the court’s judgment, for eligible educational campuses

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: India’s education infrastructure has always been the strongest foundation of its growth and development. However, recent Supreme Court judgments have reaffirmed that educational buildings exceeding 20,000 square metres require prior Environmental Clearance (EC) under the Environment Impact Assessment (EIA) Notification, 2006. Institutions that have already constructed such buildings without obtaining clearance are now left without any procedure to secure it, creating a serious obstacle. The issue has developed because of two major regulatory changes.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Before the EIA Notification, 2006, there was no built-up-area-based EC requirement for educational institutions. The Notification brought large construction projects, including educational campuses, within the prior EC framework. In December 2014, the Union government exempted schools, colleges and institutional hostels from EC, subject to environmental management conditions. The Kerala High Court quashed this exemption in March 2024. The government introduced a fresh exemption in January 2025, but Vanashakti challenged it before the Supreme Court. After staying its operation, the court cancelled the exemption in August 2025. Consequently, large educational buildings again became subject to prior EC requirements.

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #29 of 30 (19 NOV)

📰 A regulatory fix for India’s campuses

📌 Published: 19 Nov 2026, 02:23:43 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The Ministry must act without delay and issue a statutory notification, consistent with the court’s judgment, for eligible educational campuses

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: India’s education infrastructure has always been the strongest foundation of its growth and development. However, recent Supreme Court judgments have reaffirmed that educational buildings exceeding 20,000 square metres require prior Environmental Clearance (EC) under the Environment Impact Assessment (EIA) Notification, 2006. Institutions that have already constructed such buildings without obtaining clearance are now left without any procedure to secure it, creating a serious obstacle. The issue has developed because of two major regulatory changes.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Before the EIA Notification, 2006, there was no built-up-area-based EC requirement for educational institutions. The Notification brought large construction projects, including educational campuses, within the prior EC framework. In December 2014, the Union government exempted schools, colleges and institutional hostels from EC, subject to environmental management conditions. The Kerala High Court quashed this exemption in March 2024. The government introduced a fresh exemption in January 2025, but Vanashakti challenged it before the Supreme Court. After staying its operation, the court cancelled the exemption in August 2025. Consequently, large educational buildings again became subject to prior EC requirements.

Environmental (Adjective)
पर्यावरण, प्रकृति और हमारे पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र (Ecosystem) से संबंधित।
✓ Syn: Ecological, Biospheric, Natural  |  ✖ Ant: Industrial, Polluting, Synthetic
Institutional (Adjective)
संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ।
✓ Syn: Systemic, Organizational, Constitutional  |  ✖ Ant: Individual, Informal, Unorganized
Notification (Noun)
अधिसूचना — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Notification' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Construction (Noun)
निर्माण — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Construction' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🚀 Science, Tech & Environment passage on "A regulatory fix for India’s campuses", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. The Ministry must act without delay and issue a statutory notification, consistent with the court’s judgment, for eligible educational campuses.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'A regulatory fix for India’s campuses' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'A regulatory fix for India’s campuses' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'A regulatory fix for India’s campuses' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "The Ministry must act without delay and issue a statutory notification, consistent with the court’s judgment, for eligible educational campuses." (Hinglish Arth: मंत्रालय को बिना देरी किए कार्रवाई करनी चाहिए और पात्र शैक्षणिक परिसरों के लिए अदालत के फैसले के अनुरूप एक वैधानिक अधिसूचना जारी करनी चाहिए।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "A regulatory fix for India’s campuses"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Consequently, large educational buildings again became subject to prior EC requirements.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Consequently, large educational buildings again became subject to prior EC requirements." (Hinglish Arth: नतीजतन, बड़े शैक्षिक भवन फिर से पूर्व ईसी आवश्यकताओं के अधीन हो गए।)

articles.title: ‘Development has meaning only when the poor have food on their plates’, says CM D.K. Shivakumar as he inaugurates 16 Indira Canteens
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Mr. Shivakumar asked municipal bodies to ensure that the quality of food was maintained and called for CCTV cameras to be installed at the canteens, with footage monitored centrally.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: “Does hunger have a caste or religion? Does it discriminate? Even the richest person, when hungry, does not look at someone’s caste or religion before eating,” Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar said on Thursday (November 19, 2026), as he digitally inaugurated 16 new Indira Canteens across urban local bodies in Karnataka on the birth anniversary of former Prime Minister Indira Gandhi. Saying that development had meaning only when there was food on a poor person’s plate, Mr. Shivakumar said the canteens were part of Indira Gandhi’s dream of poverty eradication. Recalling her slogan ‘Garibi Hatao’, he said she had worked towards ensuring that poor people had food and the means to earn their livelihood. “The canteens were being run in her name to carry forward that vision,” he said. “Indira Canteens provide breakfast at ₹5 and meals at ₹10. They are intended to serve daily-wage workers, auto and taxi drivers, small traders and other poor people living in cities. The government plans to increase the number of canteens to over 380,” he said, adding that several outlets were yet to be completed and the pending work should be expedited. People seen in front of Indira canteen near Askok Pillar at Jayanagar, in Bengaluru. File photo. | Photo Credit: MURALI KUMAR K Mr. Shivakumar also spoke about how the idea of Indira Canteens came about. He said that during one of his visits to Sriperumbudur in Tamil Nadu, he had gone to an Amma Canteen and had breakfast for ₹5. The idli and pongal served there, and the quality of food available at such a low price, had impressed him. He later spoke to Siddaramaiah, who was then the Chief Minister, and other leaders about starting a similar initiative in Karnataka. The legislators supported the idea and suggested that it be named after Indira Gandhi. He said the Congress had always stood for the poor and weaker sections and referred to the Right to Food Act brought in during the UPA government under former Prime Minister Manmohan Singh, with Sonia Gandhi as the chairperson. He also recalled the mid-day meal programme introduced during S.M. Krishna’s tenure as Chief Minister and said the Siddaramaiah government had taken this approach forward through schemes such as Anna Bhagya and the five guarantees. “Prices are soaring while incomes are falling. Our aim is not just to remove hunger, but to ensure that everyone has protection. The faces of those who work hard should always have a smile,” he said. Mr. Shivakumar asked municipal bodies to ensure that the quality of food was maintained and called for CCTV cameras to be installed at the canteens, with footage monitored centrally. He said the system should help track how many people visited, how much food was prepared and how much was served. An elderly man having a meal at the Indira Canteen in Benson Town, in Bengaluru on February 10, 2026. | Photo Credit: ALLEN EGENUSE J

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: He also said municipal officials should be assigned specific canteens and made to visit them regularly, eat there and check the quality of food and services. Contractors too should be held accountable. “There will be no compromise on quality,” he warned, adding that officials would be held responsible for lapses even if they were committed at the behest of elected representatives.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #7 of 30 (19 NOV)

📰 ‘Development has meaning only when the poor have food on their plates’, says CM D.K. Shivakumar as he inaugurates 16 Indira Canteens

📌 Published: 19 Nov 2026, 03:14:46 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Mr. Shivakumar asked municipal bodies to ensure that the quality of food was maintained and called for CCTV cameras to be installed at the canteens, with footage monitored centrally.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: “Does hunger have a caste or religion? Does it discriminate? Even the richest person, when hungry, does not look at someone’s caste or religion before eating,” Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar said on Thursday (November 19, 2026), as he digitally inaugurated 16 new Indira Canteens across urban local bodies in Karnataka on the birth anniversary of former Prime Minister Indira Gandhi. Saying that development had meaning only when there was food on a poor person’s plate, Mr. Shivakumar said the canteens were part of Indira Gandhi’s dream of poverty eradication. Recalling her slogan ‘Garibi Hatao’, he said she had worked towards ensuring that poor people had food and the means to earn their livelihood. “The canteens were being run in her name to carry forward that vision,” he said. “Indira Canteens provide breakfast at ₹5 and meals at ₹10. They are intended to serve daily-wage workers, auto and taxi drivers, small traders and other poor people living in cities. The government plans to increase the number of canteens to over 380,” he said, adding that several outlets were yet to be completed and the pending work should be expedited. People seen in front of Indira canteen near Askok Pillar at Jayanagar, in Bengaluru. File photo. | Photo Credit: MURALI KUMAR K Mr. Shivakumar also spoke about how the idea of Indira Canteens came about. He said that during one of his visits to Sriperumbudur in Tamil Nadu, he had gone to an Amma Canteen and had breakfast for ₹5. The idli and pongal served there, and the quality of food available at such a low price, had impressed him. He later spoke to Siddaramaiah, who was then the Chief Minister, and other leaders about starting a similar initiative in Karnataka. The legislators supported the idea and suggested that it be named after Indira Gandhi. He said the Congress had always stood for the poor and weaker sections and referred to the Right to Food Act brought in during the UPA government under former Prime Minister Manmohan Singh, with Sonia Gandhi as the chairperson. He also recalled the mid-day meal programme introduced during S.M. Krishna’s tenure as Chief Minister and said the Siddaramaiah government had taken this approach forward through schemes such as Anna Bhagya and the five guarantees. “Prices are soaring while incomes are falling. Our aim is not just to remove hunger, but to ensure that everyone has protection. The faces of those who work hard should always have a smile,” he said. Mr. Shivakumar asked municipal bodies to ensure that the quality of food was maintained and called for CCTV cameras to be installed at the canteens, with footage monitored centrally. He said the system should help track how many people visited, how much food was prepared and how much was served. An elderly man having a meal at the Indira Canteen in Benson Town, in Bengaluru on February 10, 2026. | Photo Credit: ALLEN EGENUSE J

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: He also said municipal officials should be assigned specific canteens and made to visit them regularly, eat there and check the quality of food and services. Contractors too should be held accountable. “There will be no compromise on quality,” he warned, adding that officials would be held responsible for lapses even if they were committed at the behest of elected representatives.

Accountability (Noun)
जवाबदेही — अपने फैसलों और काम का जनता तथा संविधान को हिसाब देने की बाध्यता।
✓ Syn: Responsibility, Answerability, Liability  |  ✖ Ant: Immunity, Exemption, Irresponsibility
Development (Adjective)
विकास — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Development' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Eradication (Noun)
नाश — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Eradication' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Initiative (Adjective)
पहल — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Initiative' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।

articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: Mr. Shivakumar asked municipal bodies to ensure that the quality of food was maintained and called for CCTV cameras to be installed at the canteens, with footage monitored centrally.
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: “Does hunger have a caste or religion? Does it discriminate? Even the richest person, when hungry, does not look at someone’s caste or religion before eating,” Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar said on Thursday (November 19, 2026), as he digitally inaugurated 16 new Indira Canteens across urban local bodies in Karnataka on the birth anniversary of former Prime Minister Indira Gandhi. Saying that development had meaning only when there was food on a poor person’s plate, Mr. Shivakumar said the canteens were part of Indira Gandhi’s dream of poverty eradication. Recalling her slogan ‘Garibi Hatao’, he said she had worked towards ensuring that poor people had food and the means to earn their livelihood. “The canteens were being run in her name to carry forward that vision,” he said. “Indira Canteens provide breakfast at ₹5 and meals at ₹10. They are intended to serve daily-wage workers, auto and taxi drivers, small traders and other poor people living in cities. The government plans to increase the number of canteens to over 380,” he said, adding that several outlets were yet to be completed and the pending work should be expedited. People seen in front of Indira canteen near Askok Pillar at Jayanagar, in Bengaluru. File photo. | Photo Credit: MURALI KUMAR K Mr. Shivakumar also spoke about how the idea of Indira Canteens came about. He said that during one of his visits to Sriperumbudur in Tamil Nadu, he had gone to an Amma Canteen and had breakfast for ₹5. The idli and pongal served there, and the quality of food available at such a low price, had impressed him. He later spoke to Siddaramaiah, who was then the Chief Minister, and other leaders about starting a similar initiative in Karnataka. The legislators supported the idea and suggested that it be named after Indira Gandhi. He said the Congress had always stood for the poor and weaker sections and referred to the Right to Food Act brought in during the UPA government under former Prime Minister Manmohan Singh, with Sonia Gandhi as the chairperson. He also recalled the mid-day meal programme introduced during S.M. Krishna’s tenure as Chief Minister and said the Siddaramaiah government had taken this approach forward through schemes such as Anna Bhagya and the five guarantees. “Prices are soaring while incomes are falling. Our aim is not just to remove hunger, but to ensure that everyone has protection. The faces of those who work hard should always have a smile,” he said. Mr. Shivakumar asked municipal bodies to ensure that the quality of food was maintained and called for CCTV cameras to be installed at the canteens, with footage monitored centrally. He said the system should help track how many people visited, how much food was prepared and how much was served. An elderly man having a meal at the Indira Canteen in Benson Town, in Bengaluru on February 10, 2026. | Photo Credit: ALLEN EGENUSE J
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: He also said municipal officials should be assigned specific canteens and made to visit them regularly, eat there and check the quality of food and services. Contractors too should be held accountable. “There will be no compromise on quality,” he warned, adding that officials would be held responsible for lapses even if they were committed at the behest of elected representatives.

articles.title: EPFO tells trustees there’s no legal route to recover ₹1,800 crore from Reliance Capital
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: EPFO’s Central Board of Trustees will discuss the status of the outstanding default on the retirement fund’s holdings and review the annual performance of its portfolio managers at a meeting on Thursday

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The alleged siphoning of the remaining ₹1,800 crore of salaried workers’ money that Reliance Capital Ltd (RCL) has defaulted on paying to the Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) is part of the agenda of the Central Board of Trustees (CBT) meeting, scheduled to be held here on Thursday (November 19, 2026). According to the agenda note, seen by The Hindu , the EPFO may not be able to claim any more of the principal amount or interest under any legal route. Among the issues to be discussed in the meeting are the status of the outstanding default on the retirement fund’s holdings and the annual performance of its portfolio managers. CBT members will also discuss the material shared by the Enforcement Directorate (ED) on alleged fraudulent transactions, diversion of funds, irregular lending, and other alleged irregularities by the RCL. The EPFO invested ₹2,500 crore of workers’ money with the RCL in 2013 and 2014, and the latter defaulted on it and is alleged to have impaired the security available to debenture holders, including the EPFO. The EPFO’s admitted claim from the RCL was ₹3,308.67 crore, out of which ₹2,500 crore was the principal amount invested. The investment was scheduled to mature in 2023 and 2024. The custodian of the RCL, Standard Chartered Bank, has reported the receipt of ₹1,492.45 crore, i.e., 59.70% of the principal amount. “Total amount invested but not received as on 19.03.2025 is ₹1,007.55 crore, and the amount of interest admitted in Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) but not received is ₹808.67 crore,” the agenda note for Thursday’s meeting said. The agenda note, citing the legal opinion of EPFO’s lawyer, added that no further legal remedy exists for additional recovery in view of binding Supreme Court judgments, the resolution plan approved by the National Company Law Tribunal, and the full-and-final settlement nature of distributions received. “The EPFO may not be able to claim further principal or interest under any legal route,” the agenda note adds. A spokesperson for businessman Anil Ambani had earlier said that Mr. Ambani served as a non-executive director/chairman of the Board of Reliance Capital Limited from 2005 to November 2021, when the Reserve Bank of India superseded the board of directors of the company and appointed an administrator. “Mr. Ambani has denied any wrongdoing whatsoever and reserves all rights available to him in law,” the spokesperson had said. The EPFO has told its trustees that the Central Bureau of Investigation has registered a case into the matter. The organisation has written to the ED on the issue and asked the Ministry of Corporate Affairs to refer the matter to the Serious Fraud Investigation Office (SFIO). “Considering the nature of the allegations and the financial loss suffered by EPFO, legal consultation was sought on the matter. Based on the legal opinion received, a reference was made to the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) for registration of FIR, investigation into the alleged fraudulent transactions, and for such appropriate action in accordance with the law,” says the agenda note circulated among members. The meeting will also discuss the status of other defaulters, including the Uttar Pradesh Financial Corporation (outstanding interest of about ₹85 crore), Richardson & Cruddas (a penal interest of about ₹5.36 crore), Infrastructure Leasing & Financial Services Limited (a claim of ₹601.54 crore), and the Punjab State Industrial Development Corporation (₹1.10 crore interest in default).

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The meeting will also review the performance of portfolio managers such as the UTI Asset Management Company Ltd, SBI Fund Management Ltd, and four asset management companies for Exchange-Traded Fund (ETF) investments — UTI Asset Management Company Limited, SBI Funds Management Limited, ICICI Prudential Asset Management Company Limited, and Nippon India Life AMC. The evaluation report is prepared by M/s. CRISIL.

ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.question: Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "EPFO tells trustees there’s no legal route to recover ₹1,800 crore from Reliance Capital"?
options: Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
The evaluation report is prepared by M/s.
Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.answerText: The evaluation report is prepared by M/s.
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.hinglishExplanation: Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "The evaluation report is prepared by M/s." (Hinglish Arth: मूल्यांकन रिपोर्ट मैसर्स द्वारा तैयार की जाती है।)

hinglishTracks.en: EPFO’s Central Board of Trustees will discuss the status of the outstanding default on the retirement fund’s holdings and review the annual performance of its portfolio managers at a meeting on Thursday
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — ईपीएफओ का केंद्रीय न्यासी बोर्ड गुरुवार को एक बैठक में सेवानिवृत्ति निधि की होल्डिंग्स पर बकाया डिफ़ॉल्ट की स्थिति पर चर्चा करेगा और अपने पोर्टफोलियो प्रबंधकों के वार्षिक प्रदर्शन की समीक्षा करेगा।।

hinglishTracks.en: The alleged siphoning of the remaining ₹1,800 crore of salaried workers’ money that Reliance Capital Ltd (RCL) has defaulted on paying to the Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) is part of the agenda of the Central Board of Trustees (CBT) meeting, scheduled to be held here on Thursday (November 19, 2026).
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — वेतनभोगी कर्मचारियों के शेष ₹1,800 करोड़ की कथित हेराफेरी, जिसे रिलायंस कैपिटल लिमिटेड (आरसीएल) ने कर्मचारी भविष्य निधि संगठन (ईपीएफओ) को भुगतान करने में चूक कर दी है, केंद्रीय न्यासी बोर्ड (सीबीटी) की बैठक के एजेंडे का हिस्सा है, जो गुरुवार (19 नवंबर, 2026) को यहां होने वाली है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Organisation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संगठन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Organisation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: According to the agenda note, seen by The Hindu , the EPFO may not be able to claim any more of the principal amount or interest under any legal route.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — द हिंदू द्वारा देखे गए एजेंडा नोट के अनुसार, ईपीएफओ किसी भी कानूनी मार्ग के तहत मूल राशि या ब्याज का दावा करने में सक्षम नहीं हो सकता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Among the issues to be discussed in the meeting are the status of the outstanding default on the retirement fund’s holdings and the annual performance of its portfolio managers.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — बैठक में जिन मुद्दों पर चर्चा होनी है उनमें सेवानिवृत्ति निधि की होल्डिंग्स पर बकाया डिफॉल्ट की स्थिति और इसके पोर्टफोलियो प्रबंधकों का वार्षिक प्रदर्शन शामिल हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: CBT members will also discuss the material shared by the Enforcement Directorate (ED) on alleged fraudulent transactions, diversion of funds, irregular lending, and other alleged irregularities by the RCL.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — सीबीटी सदस्य कथित धोखाधड़ी वाले लेनदेन, धन के हेरफेर, अनियमित उधार और आरसीएल द्वारा अन्य कथित अनियमितताओं पर प्रवर्तन निदेशालय (ईडी) द्वारा साझा की गई सामग्री पर भी चर्चा करेंगे।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Enforcement' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: सख्ती से कानून लागू करना — किसी नियम या आदेश का ज़मीनी स्तर पर पालन करवाना। इसके Synonyms हैं: Implementation, Execution, Administration और Antonyms हैं: Neglect, Abandonment, Waiver।

hinglishTracks.en: The EPFO invested ₹2,500 crore of workers’ money with the RCL in 2013 and 2014, and the latter defaulted on it and is alleged to have impaired the security available to debenture holders, including the EPFO.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — ईपीएफओ ने 2013 और 2014 में आरसीएल के साथ श्रमिकों के 2,500 करोड़ रुपये का निवेश किया, और बाद में इसमें चूक हुई और आरोप है कि उसने ईपीएफओ सहित डिबेंचर धारकों को उपलब्ध सुरक्षा को नुकसान पहुंचाया है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Investigation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: जाँच पड़ताल — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Investigation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse और Antonyms हैं: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable।

hinglishTracks.en: The EPFO’s admitted claim from the RCL was ₹3,308.67 crore, out of which ₹2,500 crore was the principal amount invested.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — आरसीएल से ईपीएफओ का स्वीकृत दावा ₹3,308.67 करोड़ था, जिसमें से ₹2,500 करोड़ निवेश की गई मूल राशि थी।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Investigation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: जाँच पड़ताल — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Investigation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse और Antonyms हैं: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable।

hinglishTracks.en: The investment was scheduled to mature in 2023 and 2024.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — निवेश 2023 और 2024 में परिपक्व होने वाला था।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Investigation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: जाँच पड़ताल — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Investigation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse और Antonyms हैं: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable।

hinglishTracks.en: The custodian of the RCL, Standard Chartered Bank, has reported the receipt of ₹1,492.45 crore, i.e., 59.70% of the principal amount.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — आरसीएल के संरक्षक, स्टैंडर्ड चार्टर्ड बैंक ने ₹1,492.45 करोड़, यानी मूल राशि का 59.70% प्राप्त होने की सूचना दी है।।

hinglishTracks.en: “Total amount invested but not received as on 19.03.2025 is ₹1,007.55 crore, and the amount of interest admitted in Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) but not received is ₹808.67 crore,” the agenda note for Thursday’s meeting said.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — गुरुवार की बैठक के एजेंडा नोट में कहा गया है, "19.03.2025 तक निवेश की गई लेकिन प्राप्त नहीं हुई कुल राशि ₹1,007.55 करोड़ है, और कॉर्पोरेट दिवाला समाधान प्रक्रिया (सीआईआरपी) में स्वीकृत लेकिन प्राप्त नहीं हुई ब्याज की राशि ₹808.67 करोड़ है।"। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Investigation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: जाँच पड़ताल — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Investigation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse और Antonyms हैं: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable।

hinglishTracks.en: The agenda note, citing the legal opinion of EPFO’s lawyer, added that no further legal remedy exists for additional recovery in view of binding Supreme Court judgments, the resolution plan approved by the National Company Law Tribunal, and the full-and-final settlement nature of distributions received.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — एजेंडा नोट में ईपीएफओ के वकील की कानूनी राय का हवाला देते हुए कहा गया है कि सुप्रीम कोर्ट के बाध्यकारी फैसलों, राष्ट्रीय कंपनी कानून न्यायाधिकरण द्वारा अनुमोदित समाधान योजना और प्राप्त वितरणों की पूर्ण और अंतिम निपटान प्रकृति के मद्देनजर अतिरिक्त वसूली के लिए कोई और कानूनी उपाय मौजूद नहीं है।।

hinglishTracks.en: “The EPFO may not be able to claim further principal or interest under any legal route,” the agenda note adds.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — एजेंडा नोट में कहा गया है, ''ईपीएफओ किसी भी कानूनी रास्ते के तहत आगे मूलधन या ब्याज का दावा करने में सक्षम नहीं हो सकता है।''।

hinglishTracks.en: A spokesperson for businessman Anil Ambani had earlier said that Mr.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — बिजनेसमैन अनिल अंबानी के प्रवक्ता ने पहले कहा था कि श्री.।

hinglishTracks.en: Ambani served as a non-executive director/chairman of the Board of Reliance Capital Limited from 2005 to November 2021, when the Reserve Bank of India superseded the board of directors of the company and appointed an administrator.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — अंबानी ने 2005 से नवंबर 2021 तक रिलायंस कैपिटल लिमिटेड के बोर्ड के गैर-कार्यकारी निदेशक/अध्यक्ष के रूप में कार्य किया, जब भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक ने कंपनी के निदेशक मंडल को हटा दिया और एक प्रशासक नियुक्त किया।।

hinglishTracks.en: Ambani has denied any wrongdoing whatsoever and reserves all rights available to him in law,” the spokesperson had said.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — अंबानी ने किसी भी तरह के गलत काम से इनकार किया है और कानून में उनके पास उपलब्ध सभी अधिकार सुरक्षित हैं, ”प्रवक्ता ने कहा था।।

hinglishTracks.en: The EPFO has told its trustees that the Central Bureau of Investigation has registered a case into the matter.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — ईपीएफओ ने अपने ट्रस्टियों से कहा है कि केंद्रीय जांच ब्यूरो ने इस मामले में मामला दर्ज कर लिया है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Investigation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: जाँच पड़ताल — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Investigation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse और Antonyms हैं: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable।

hinglishTracks.en: The organisation has written to the ED on the issue and asked the Ministry of Corporate Affairs to refer the matter to the Serious Fraud Investigation Office (SFIO).
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — संगठन ने इस मुद्दे पर ईडी को पत्र लिखा है और कॉर्पोरेट मामलों के मंत्रालय से मामले को गंभीर धोखाधड़ी जांच कार्यालय (एसएफआईओ) को सौंपने के लिए कहा है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Investigation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: जाँच पड़ताल — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Investigation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse और Antonyms हैं: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable।

hinglishTracks.en: “Considering the nature of the allegations and the financial loss suffered by EPFO, legal consultation was sought on the matter.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — “आरोपों की प्रकृति और ईपीएफओ को हुए वित्तीय नुकसान को ध्यान में रखते हुए, मामले पर कानूनी परामर्श मांगा गया था।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Consultation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: परामर्श — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Consultation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: Based on the legal opinion received, a reference was made to the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) for registration of FIR, investigation into the alleged fraudulent transactions, and for such appropriate action in accordance with the law,” says the agenda note circulated among members.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #9 of 30 (19 NOV)

📰 EPFO tells trustees there’s no legal route to recover ₹1,800 crore from Reliance Capital

📌 Published: 19 Nov 2026, 03:08:37 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: EPFO’s Central Board of Trustees will discuss the status of the outstanding default on the retirement fund’s holdings and review the annual performance of its portfolio managers at a meeting on Thursday

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The alleged siphoning of the remaining ₹1,800 crore of salaried workers’ money that Reliance Capital Ltd (RCL) has defaulted on paying to the Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) is part of the agenda of the Central Board of Trustees (CBT) meeting, scheduled to be held here on Thursday (November 19, 2026). According to the agenda note, seen by The Hindu , the EPFO may not be able to claim any more of the principal amount or interest under any legal route. Among the issues to be discussed in the meeting are the status of the outstanding default on the retirement fund’s holdings and the annual performance of its portfolio managers. CBT members will also discuss the material shared by the Enforcement Directorate (ED) on alleged fraudulent transactions, diversion of funds, irregular lending, and other alleged irregularities by the RCL. The EPFO invested ₹2,500 crore of workers’ money with the RCL in 2013 and 2014, and the latter defaulted on it and is alleged to have impaired the security available to debenture holders, including the EPFO. The EPFO’s admitted claim from the RCL was ₹3,308.67 crore, out of which ₹2,500 crore was the principal amount invested. The investment was scheduled to mature in 2023 and 2024. The custodian of the RCL, Standard Chartered Bank, has reported the receipt of ₹1,492.45 crore, i.e., 59.70% of the principal amount. “Total amount invested but not received as on 19.03.2025 is ₹1,007.55 crore, and the amount of interest admitted in Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) but not received is ₹808.67 crore,” the agenda note for Thursday’s meeting said. The agenda note, citing the legal opinion of EPFO’s lawyer, added that no further legal remedy exists for additional recovery in view of binding Supreme Court judgments, the resolution plan approved by the National Company Law Tribunal, and the full-and-final settlement nature of distributions received. “The EPFO may not be able to claim further principal or interest under any legal route,” the agenda note adds. A spokesperson for businessman Anil Ambani had earlier said that Mr. Ambani served as a non-executive director/chairman of the Board of Reliance Capital Limited from 2005 to November 2021, when the Reserve Bank of India superseded the board of directors of the company and appointed an administrator. “Mr. Ambani has denied any wrongdoing whatsoever and reserves all rights available to him in law,” the spokesperson had said. The EPFO has told its trustees that the Central Bureau of Investigation has registered a case into the matter. The organisation has written to the ED on the issue and asked the Ministry of Corporate Affairs to refer the matter to the Serious Fraud Investigation Office (SFIO). “Considering the nature of the allegations and the financial loss suffered by EPFO, legal consultation was sought on the matter. Based on the legal opinion received, a reference was made to the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) for registration of FIR, investigation into the alleged fraudulent transactions, and for such appropriate action in accordance with the law,” says the agenda note circulated among members. The meeting will also discuss the status of other defaulters, including the Uttar Pradesh Financial Corporation (outstanding interest of about ₹85 crore), Richardson & Cruddas (a penal interest of about ₹5.36 crore), Infrastructure Leasing & Financial Services Limited (a claim of ₹601.54 crore), and the Punjab State Industrial Development Corporation (₹1.10 crore interest in default).

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The meeting will also review the performance of portfolio managers such as the UTI Asset Management Company Ltd, SBI Fund Management Ltd, and four asset management companies for Exchange-Traded Fund (ETF) investments — UTI Asset Management Company Limited, SBI Funds Management Limited, ICICI Prudential Asset Management Company Limited, and Nippon India Life AMC. The evaluation report is prepared by M/s. CRISIL.

✓ Syn: Implementation, Execution, Administration  |  ✖ Ant: Neglect, Abandonment, Waiver

✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Consultation (Noun)
परामर्श — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Consultation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।

✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "The evaluation report is prepared by M/s." (Hinglish Arth: मूल्यांकन रिपोर्ट मैसर्स द्वारा तैयार की जाती है।)

articles.title: PM Modi invites suggestions from India Inc on further reforms
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: While the government has reduced the corporate tax, Mr. Modi asked if the industry has increased the strength of employees and raised their wages

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Thursday (November 19, 2026) asked India Inc to suggest, without any hesitation or reluctance, more reforms that are necessary for further growth of the country. Addressing industry body FICCI Annual General Meeting and Annual Convention, the Prime Minister also asked corporates to focus on making India self-reliant, and urged them to invest heavily in agriculture and allied sectors. Mr. Modi highlighted achievements of his government in the last 12-13 years, and lauded efforts made by all sections of the society. India's growth story is creating new opportunities. Our industries must be ready to seize them. Speaking at FICCI's centenary convention. @ficci_india https://t.co/tJCw2NnpjW He said the pace of progress in India is very fast, and at the same time, the speed at which people are moving out of poverty is also very fast. Citing the latest World Bank report, Mr. Modi said in just 12–13 years, 50 crore people have overcome poverty. Mr. Modi said the basic corporate tax rate has been reduced from 30% in 2014 to 22%, and individual income of up to ₹12 lakh a year is also tax-free. While the government has reduced the corporate tax, he asked if the industry has increased the strength of employees and raised their wages. He also emphasised that a country progresses when it respects its farmers, small entrepreneurs, industries, wealth creators and taxpayers, and not by hurling abuses day-in and day-out.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Taking a jibe at past regimes, Mr. Modi said the industry's experience with previous governments has been so bitter that he has to bear the consequences.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #10 of 30 (19 NOV)

📰 PM Modi invites suggestions from India Inc on further reforms

📌 Published: 19 Nov 2026, 03:08:31 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: While the government has reduced the corporate tax, Mr. Modi asked if the industry has increased the strength of employees and raised their wages

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Thursday (November 19, 2026) asked India Inc to suggest, without any hesitation or reluctance, more reforms that are necessary for further growth of the country. Addressing industry body FICCI Annual General Meeting and Annual Convention, the Prime Minister also asked corporates to focus on making India self-reliant, and urged them to invest heavily in agriculture and allied sectors. Mr. Modi highlighted achievements of his government in the last 12-13 years, and lauded efforts made by all sections of the society. India's growth story is creating new opportunities. Our industries must be ready to seize them. Speaking at FICCI's centenary convention. @ficci_india https://t.co/tJCw2NnpjW He said the pace of progress in India is very fast, and at the same time, the speed at which people are moving out of poverty is also very fast. Citing the latest World Bank report, Mr. Modi said in just 12–13 years, 50 crore people have overcome poverty. Mr. Modi said the basic corporate tax rate has been reduced from 30% in 2014 to 22%, and individual income of up to ₹12 lakh a year is also tax-free. While the government has reduced the corporate tax, he asked if the industry has increased the strength of employees and raised their wages. He also emphasised that a country progresses when it respects its farmers, small entrepreneurs, industries, wealth creators and taxpayers, and not by hurling abuses day-in and day-out.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Taking a jibe at past regimes, Mr. Modi said the industry's experience with previous governments has been so bitter that he has to bear the consequences.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Hesitation (Noun)
संकोच — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Hesitation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।

✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Convention (Noun)
सम्मेलन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Convention' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Individual (Adjective)
व्यक्ति — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Individual' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "PM Modi invites suggestions from India Inc on further reforms", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. While the government has reduced the corporate tax, Mr.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'PM Modi invites suggestions from India Inc on fu' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'PM Modi invites suggestions from India Inc on' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'PM Modi invites suggestions from India Inc on' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "While the government has reduced the corporate tax, Mr." (Hinglish Arth: वहीं सरकार ने कॉरपोरेट टैक्स कम कर दिया है.)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "PM Modi invites suggestions from India Inc on further reforms"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Modi said the industry's experience with previous governments has been so bitter that he has to bear the consequences.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Modi said the industry's experience with previous governments has been so bitter that he has to bear the consequences." articles.title: Cyclone ‘Akvan’ heads for Odisha; over one lakh people evacuated
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Odisha Government closes coastal tourist sites including Chilika Lake, Puri beaches, Bhitarakanika and Nandankanan Zoological Park

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Odisha on Thursday (November 19, 2026) stepped up evacuation of people, positioning of disaster response forces and emptying of reservoirs in southern and coastal districts as the Severe Cyclonic Storm ‘Akvan’ is expected cross the State’s coast, close to east of Gopalpur, by noon of November 20. Office of Special Relief Commissioner said more than one lakh people, including close to 10,000 pregnant women, have been shifted to safer places. While Ganjam district under which Gopalpur lies alone has shifted over 50,000 people, Gajapati and Kandhamal districts have relocated 16,000 and 3000 people respectively. Follow Cyclone ‘Akvan’ LIVE updates on November 19 Ghat roads (hill passes) such as Kalinga and Gajalbadi connecting Ganjam and Kandhamal districts have been barricaded, apprehending landslides. “The Severe Cyclonic Storm “Akvan” over the westcentral Bay of Bengal moved northwards with the speed of 15 kmph during past six hours and lay centered about 420 km east-southeast of Narsapur (Andhra Pradesh), 400 km south-southeast of Kalingapatnam (Andhra Pradesh), 490 km south of Gopalpur (Odisha) and 550 km south of Puri (Odisha) and 590 km east-northeast of Chennai (Tamil Nadu),” the India Meteorological Department announced in a bulletin. The IMD bulletin said it is likely to move north-northwestward and cross North Andhra Pradesh and Yanam and South Odisha coasts between Narsapur and Puri, close to east of Gopalpur, by noon of November 20, 2026, with maximum sustained wind speed of 90-100 kmph gusting to 110 kmph. Experts, however, said the windspeed could come down to 70 to 80 km per hour when the cyclone would cross the coast. A red warning for heavy to very heavy rainfall has been issued for Kendrapada, Jagatsinghpur, Puri, Ganjam, Gajapati, and Kandhamal districts. Gopalpur Port authorities have secured machineries and ships in view advancing cyclone after the government’s warning. “Water resources department has started depleting reservoirs in districts to be affected by the cyclone. Engineers are continuously monitoring situation while technical teams have been deployed. Two gates of major dam and 23 gates of different medium irrigation dams are kept opened,” said Odisha Chief Secretary Anu Garg.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: A man, identified Santosh Palaka (38), went missing when river water level in Sana Nadi rises in Gudari block of Rayagada district after water from Harabhangi dam was released.

hinglishTracks.en: Odisha Government closes coastal tourist sites including Chilika Lake, Puri beaches, Bhitarakanika and Nandankanan Zoological Park
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — ओडिशा सरकार ने चिल्का झील, पुरी समुद्र तट, भितरकनिका और नंदनकानन प्राणी उद्यान सहित तटीय पर्यटन स्थलों को बंद कर दिया है। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Zoological' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: जूलॉजिकल — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Zoological' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: Odisha on Thursday (November 19, 2026) stepped up evacuation of people, positioning of disaster response forces and emptying of reservoirs in southern and coastal districts as the Severe Cyclonic Storm ‘Akvan’ is expected cross the State’s coast, close to east of Gopalpur, by noon of November 20.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — ओडिशा ने गुरुवार (19 नवंबर, 2026) को लोगों को निकालने, आपदा प्रतिक्रिया बलों की तैनाती और दक्षिणी और तटीय जिलों में जलाशयों को खाली करने का काम तेज कर दिया, क्योंकि गंभीर चक्रवाती तूफान 'अकवन' के 20 नवंबर की दोपहर तक गोपालपुर के पूर्व में राज्य के तट को पार करने की उम्मीद है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Office of Special Relief Commissioner said more than one lakh people, including close to 10,000 pregnant women, have been shifted to safer places.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — विशेष राहत आयुक्त कार्यालय ने कहा कि करीब 10,000 गर्भवती महिलाओं सहित एक लाख से अधिक लोगों को सुरक्षित स्थानों पर पहुंचाया गया है।।

hinglishTracks.en: While Ganjam district under which Gopalpur lies alone has shifted over 50,000 people, Gajapati and Kandhamal districts have relocated 16,000 and 3000 people respectively.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — जबकि गंजम जिला जिसके अंतर्गत गोपालपुर अकेला पड़ता है, 50,000 से अधिक लोगों को स्थानांतरित किया गया है, गजपति और कंधमाल जिलों ने क्रमशः 16,000 और 3000 लोगों को स्थानांतरित किया है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Follow Cyclone ‘Akvan’ LIVE updates on November 19
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — 19 नवंबर को चक्रवात 'अकवन' के लाइव अपडेट का पालन करें।

hinglishTracks.en: Ghat roads (hill passes) such as Kalinga and Gajalbadi connecting Ganjam and Kandhamal districts have been barricaded, apprehending landslides.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — भूस्खलन की आशंका के चलते गंजम और कंधमाल जिलों को जोड़ने वाली कलिंग और गजलबाड़ी जैसी घाट सड़कों (पहाड़ी दर्रों) पर बैरिकेड लगा दिए गए हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: “The Severe Cyclonic Storm “Akvan” over the westcentral Bay of Bengal moved northwards with the speed of 15 kmph during past six hours and lay centered about 420 km east-southeast of Narsapur (Andhra Pradesh), 400 km south-southeast of Kalingapatnam (Andhra Pradesh), 490 km south of Gopalpur (Odisha) and 550 km south of Puri (Odisha) and 590 km east-northeast of Chennai (Tamil Nadu),” the India Meteorological Department announced in a bulletin.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — बंगाल की पश्चिम-मध्य खाड़ी के ऊपर भीषण चक्रवाती तूफान "अकवन" पिछले छह घंटों के दौरान 15 किमी प्रति घंटे की गति से उत्तर की ओर बढ़ा और नरसापुर (आंध्र प्रदेश) से लगभग 420 किमी पूर्व-दक्षिणपूर्व, कलिंगपट्टनम (आंध्र प्रदेश) से 400 किमी दक्षिण-दक्षिणपूर्व, गोपालपुर (ओडिशा) से 490 किमी दक्षिण और पुरी (ओडिशा) से 550 किमी दक्षिण और 590 किमी दूर केंद्रित था। चेन्नई (तमिलनाडु) से किमी पूर्व-उत्तरपूर्व में, “भारत मौसम विज्ञान विभाग ने एक बुलेटिन में घोषणा की।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Meteorological' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: मौसम विज्ञान और वायुमंडलीय परिवर्तनों से संबंधित (Connected with weather forecasting and atmospheric shifts). इसके Synonyms हैं: Atmospheric, Climatic, Weather-related और Antonyms हैं: Geological, Subterranean, Terrestrial।

hinglishTracks.en: The IMD bulletin said it is likely to move north-northwestward and cross North Andhra Pradesh and Yanam and South Odisha coasts between Narsapur and Puri, close to east of Gopalpur, by noon of November 20, 2026, with maximum sustained wind speed of 90-100 kmph gusting to 110 kmph.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — आईएमडी बुलेटिन में कहा गया है कि इसके उत्तर-उत्तर-पश्चिम की ओर बढ़ने और 20 नवंबर, 2026 की दोपहर तक गोपालपुर के पूर्व में नरसापुर और पुरी के बीच उत्तरी आंध्र प्रदेश और यनम और दक्षिण ओडिशा तटों को पार करने की संभावना है, जिसमें 90-100 किमी प्रति घंटे की अधिकतम निरंतर हवा की गति 110 किमी प्रति घंटे तक पहुंच सकती है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Sustainability' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: सतत विकास — पर्यावरण और भविष्य की पीढ़ियों को नुकसान पहुँचाए बिना लंबे समय तक चलने वाला विकास। इसके Synonyms हैं: Viability, Eco-balance, Durability और Antonyms हैं: Depletion, Unsustainability, Destruction।

hinglishTracks.en: Experts, however, said the windspeed could come down to 70 to 80 km per hour when the cyclone would cross the coast.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — हालांकि, विशेषज्ञों ने कहा कि जब चक्रवात तट को पार करेगा तो हवा की गति 70 से 80 किमी प्रति घंटे तक कम हो सकती है।।

hinglishTracks.en: A red warning for heavy to very heavy rainfall has been issued for Kendrapada, Jagatsinghpur, Puri, Ganjam, Gajapati, and Kandhamal districts.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — केंद्रपाड़ा, जगतसिंहपुर, पुरी, गंजम, गजपति और कंधमाल जिलों के लिए भारी से बहुत भारी वर्षा की लाल चेतावनी जारी की गई है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Gopalpur Port authorities have secured machineries and ships in view advancing cyclone after the government’s warning.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — सरकार की चेतावनी के बाद गोपालपुर बंदरगाह के अधिकारियों ने चक्रवात के आगे बढ़ने के मद्देनजर मशीनरी और जहाजों को सुरक्षित कर लिया है।।

hinglishTracks.en: “Water resources department has started depleting reservoirs in districts to be affected by the cyclone.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — “जल संसाधन विभाग ने चक्रवात से प्रभावित होने वाले जिलों में जलाशयों को ख़त्म करना शुरू कर दिया है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Engineers are continuously monitoring situation while technical teams have been deployed.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — इंजीनियर लगातार स्थिति पर नजर रख रहे हैं जबकि तकनीकी टीमें तैनात की गई हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: Two gates of major dam and 23 gates of different medium irrigation dams are kept opened,” said Odisha Chief Secretary Anu Garg.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — प्रमुख बांध के दो गेट और विभिन्न मध्यम सिंचाई बांधों के 23 गेट खुले रखे गए हैं, ”ओडिशा के मुख्य सचिव अनु गर्ग ने कहा।।

hinglishTracks.en: A man, identified Santosh Palaka (38), went missing when river water level in Sana Nadi rises in Gudari block of Rayagada district after water from Harabhangi dam was released.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — हरभंगी बांध से पानी छोड़े जाने के बाद रायगड़ा जिले के गुडरी ब्लॉक में सना नदी में नदी का जल स्तर बढ़ने पर संतोष पलाका (38) नाम का एक व्यक्ति लापता हो गया।।

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #11 of 30 (19 NOV)

📰 Cyclone ‘Akvan’ heads for Odisha; over one lakh people evacuated

📌 Published: 19 Nov 2026, 03:07:28 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Odisha Government closes coastal tourist sites including Chilika Lake, Puri beaches, Bhitarakanika and Nandankanan Zoological Park

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Odisha on Thursday (November 19, 2026) stepped up evacuation of people, positioning of disaster response forces and emptying of reservoirs in southern and coastal districts as the Severe Cyclonic Storm ‘Akvan’ is expected cross the State’s coast, close to east of Gopalpur, by noon of November 20. Office of Special Relief Commissioner said more than one lakh people, including close to 10,000 pregnant women, have been shifted to safer places. While Ganjam district under which Gopalpur lies alone has shifted over 50,000 people, Gajapati and Kandhamal districts have relocated 16,000 and 3000 people respectively. Follow Cyclone ‘Akvan’ LIVE updates on November 19 Ghat roads (hill passes) such as Kalinga and Gajalbadi connecting Ganjam and Kandhamal districts have been barricaded, apprehending landslides. “The Severe Cyclonic Storm “Akvan” over the westcentral Bay of Bengal moved northwards with the speed of 15 kmph during past six hours and lay centered about 420 km east-southeast of Narsapur (Andhra Pradesh), 400 km south-southeast of Kalingapatnam (Andhra Pradesh), 490 km south of Gopalpur (Odisha) and 550 km south of Puri (Odisha) and 590 km east-northeast of Chennai (Tamil Nadu),” the India Meteorological Department announced in a bulletin. The IMD bulletin said it is likely to move north-northwestward and cross North Andhra Pradesh and Yanam and South Odisha coasts between Narsapur and Puri, close to east of Gopalpur, by noon of November 20, 2026, with maximum sustained wind speed of 90-100 kmph gusting to 110 kmph. Experts, however, said the windspeed could come down to 70 to 80 km per hour when the cyclone would cross the coast. A red warning for heavy to very heavy rainfall has been issued for Kendrapada, Jagatsinghpur, Puri, Ganjam, Gajapati, and Kandhamal districts. Gopalpur Port authorities have secured machineries and ships in view advancing cyclone after the government’s warning. “Water resources department has started depleting reservoirs in districts to be affected by the cyclone. Engineers are continuously monitoring situation while technical teams have been deployed. Two gates of major dam and 23 gates of different medium irrigation dams are kept opened,” said Odisha Chief Secretary Anu Garg.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: A man, identified Santosh Palaka (38), went missing when river water level in Sana Nadi rises in Gudari block of Rayagada district after water from Harabhangi dam was released.

✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile

articles.title: Japanese PM Takaichi calls for continued dialogue with China to ease bilateral tensions
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Earlier in the day, Ms. Takaichi shook hands with Chinese President Xi Jinping and later held a meeting with Russian President Vladimir Putin

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi on Thursday (November 19, 2026) called for continued dialogue and communication with China to ease bilateral tensions triggered by her remarks on Taiwan, saying Beijing is an "important neighbour" with which Tokyo has several outstanding issues. Ms. Takaichi is in Shenzhen to attend the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Economic Leaders' Meeting. "China is an important neighbour, and between the two countries there are outstanding issues, and that is why it is important to continue communicating and having dialogue,” she told the media on the sidelines of the APEC summit. Earlier in the day, Ms. Takaichi shook hands with Chinese President Xi Jinping and later held a meeting with Russian President Vladimir Putin. When asked about her brief interaction with Mr. Xi, the Japanese PM said she thanked him for the invitation and congratulated him on successfully hosting the APEC summit. Relations between Tokyo and Beijing have sharply deteriorated after Takaichi told parliament in November last year that a Chinese attack on Taiwan, a self-governed island claimed by China, could trigger a situation in which Japan's Self-Defence Forces might support US forces. Her remarks infuriated China, prompting it to take a series of political and economic measures against Japan, including export restrictions on rare earths used in a wide range of high-tech products. Asked about the controversy, Ms. Takaichi said Japan's four political documents governing its relations with China remained unchanged and continued to serve as the foundation of bilateral ties. Tokyo will continue to advance a comprehensive strategic relationship of mutual benefit with Beijing while pursuing dialogue to protect their respective national interests and build constructive and stable ties, she said, according to the Hong Kong-based South China Morning Post.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Ms. Takaichi refrained from commenting on a hypothetical Taiwan contingency, saying Japan's position on Taiwan, as articulated in the 1972 Japan-China Joint Communique, remained unchanged.

Relations between Tokyo and Beijing have sharply deteriorated after Takaichi told parliament in November last year that a Chinese attack on Taiwan, a self-governed island claimed by China, could trigger a situation in which Japan's Self-Defence Forces might support US forces. Her remarks infuriated China, prompting it to take a series of political and economic measures against Japan, including export restrictions on rare earths used in a wide range of high-tech products. Asked about the controversy, Ms. Takaichi said Japan's four political documents governing its relations with China remained unchanged and continued to serve as the foundation of bilateral ties. Tokyo will continue to advance a comprehensive strategic relationship of mutual benefit with Beijing while pursuing dialogue to protect their respective national interests and build constructive and stable ties, she said, according to the Hong Kong-based South China Morning Post.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Ms. Takaichi refrained from commenting on a hypothetical Taiwan contingency, saying Japan's position on Taiwan, as articulated in the 1972 Japan-China Joint Communique, remained unchanged.

📰 Japanese PM Takaichi calls for continued dialogue with China to ease bilateral tensions

📌 Published: 19 Nov 2026, 02:21:38 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Earlier in the day, Ms. Takaichi shook hands with Chinese President Xi Jinping and later held a meeting with Russian President Vladimir Putin

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi on Thursday (November 19, 2026) called for continued dialogue and communication with China to ease bilateral tensions triggered by her remarks on Taiwan, saying Beijing is an "important neighbour" with which Tokyo has several outstanding issues. Ms. Takaichi is in Shenzhen to attend the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Economic Leaders' Meeting. "China is an important neighbour, and between the two countries there are outstanding issues, and that is why it is important to continue communicating and having dialogue,” she told the media on the sidelines of the APEC summit. Earlier in the day, Ms. Takaichi shook hands with Chinese President Xi Jinping and later held a meeting with Russian President Vladimir Putin. When asked about her brief interaction with Mr. Xi, the Japanese PM said she thanked him for the invitation and congratulated him on successfully hosting the APEC summit. Relations between Tokyo and Beijing have sharply deteriorated after Takaichi told parliament in November last year that a Chinese attack on Taiwan, a self-governed island claimed by China, could trigger a situation in which Japan's Self-Defence Forces might support US forces. Her remarks infuriated China, prompting it to take a series of political and economic measures against Japan, including export restrictions on rare earths used in a wide range of high-tech products. Asked about the controversy, Ms. Takaichi said Japan's four political documents governing its relations with China remained unchanged and continued to serve as the foundation of bilateral ties. Tokyo will continue to advance a comprehensive strategic relationship of mutual benefit with Beijing while pursuing dialogue to protect their respective national interests and build constructive and stable ties, she said, according to the Hong Kong-based South China Morning Post.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Ms. Takaichi refrained from commenting on a hypothetical Taiwan contingency, saying Japan's position on Taiwan, as articulated in the 1972 Japan-China Joint Communique, remained unchanged.
